name: Public Health Birth Data: Sociodemographic Characteristics of Mother
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Source data does not differentiate between gender and sex assigned at birth. For clarity and brevity, metadata descriptions reflect gendered language with the understanding that these descriptions may not accurately reflect all cases.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Place
columns.description: CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Race and Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of mother. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic". "PI" refers to "Pacific Islander".

columns.name: Count of Medicaid Recipients
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who were enrolled in Medicaid at the time of delivery

columns.name: Rate of Medicaid Recipients
columns.description: Number of births to mothers receiving Medicaid benefits per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Births to Mothers Over Twenty Without Diplomas
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers aged 20 or older who have not completed high school or obtained an equivalent credential

columns.name: Rate of Births to Mothers Over Twenty Without Diplomas
columns.description: Number of births to mothers 20 years of age or older with education below 12th grade per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of WIC Recipients
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who received WIC (Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children) benefits during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of WIC Recipients
columns.description: Number of births to mothers receiving WIC (Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children) benefits per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Missing Father Information
columns.description: Total number of births with missing or unreported paternal information on the birth certificate

columns.name: Rate of Missing Father Information
columns.description: Number of births with missing information for father per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Unmarried Births
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who were unmarried at the time of delivery

columns.name: Rate of Unmarried Births
columns.description: Number of births to mothers that are unmarried at time of delivery per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Teenage Births
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers under 20 years of age. This data is only available for the "Under 20" age group.

columns.name: Rate of Teenage Births
columns.description: Number of births to mother under 20 years of age per 100 live births. This data is only available for the "Under 20" age group.
